import pandas as pd

def run(inputs: dict) -> dict:
    df = inputs["transactions"].copy()

    df = df.sort_values(
        by=["account_id", "txn_date", "txn_seq"],
        kind="mergesort"
    ).reset_index(drop=True)

    amt_filled = df["amount"].fillna(0.0)

    # cumulative sum, reset at each account boundary
    grp_cum = amt_filled.groupby(df["account_id"]).cumsum()

    df["running_balance"] = grp_cum
    df["overdraft_flag"] = (df["running_balance"] < 0).astype("int64")

    out = df[
        ["account_id", "txn_seq", "txn_date", "amount",
         "running_balance", "overdraft_flag"]
    ].reset_index(drop=True)

    return {"acct_balance_flags": out}
